metadata.title: [CHORE]: MCP server quick add dialog from a new MCP catalog
metadata.author: a-effort

description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

 Add a "Quick Add" dialog to the Add MCP Server flow in the new React-based Admin UI. The dialog surfaces a curated shortlist of commonly used MCP servers from the server catalog so users can register them in one click (if OAuth is not required), with a link to browse the full catalog for everything else. [Design](https://www.figma.com/design/H2Dr9QPvRVxCe92V8URvGT/Refiring?m=auto&node-id=2924-4903&t=GfuggJqUPHUAkXP1-1)                        
                                                                                                                                                           
Parent epic: #4093 — Frontend refactor and redesign (Replace HTMX with React + Shadcn + Vite). 

---

### 🧱 Area Affected
                                                                                                                                                 
  - GitHub Actions / CI Pipelines
  - Pre-commit hooks / linters                                                                                                                             
  - Formatting (black, isort, ruff, etc.)                                                                                                                  
  - Type-checking (mypy, pyright, pytype, etc.)                                                                                                            
  - Dependency cleanup or updates                                                                                                                          
  - Build system or Makefile                                                                                                                               
  - Containerization (Docker/Podman)                                                                                                                       
  - Docs or spellcheck                                                                                                                                   
  - SBOM, CVE scans, licenses, or security checks                                                                                                          
  - Other: New React Admin UI — Add MCP Server flow / onboarding UX  
  
---

### ⚙️ Context / Rationale

The current "Add MCP Server" experience requires users to know the server's command, transport, and configuration up front, which is friction during first-run onboarding and repetitive when re-adding well-known servers. As part of the frontend rewrite (#4093), we have an opportunity to make Core Flow #1 ("Add/configure MCP servers") quicker / easier by surfacing a curated shortlist of commonly used servers from the catalog directly in the add dialog. A link to the catalog preserves discoverability of the full set.                                                                                                             

Net effect: faster time-to-first-server for new users and fewer misconfigured registrations.

---

### 📦 Related Make Targets

(The new UI lives outside the legacy HTMX bundle, so most relevant tooling will be Vite/npm rather than the existing make build-ui target. Update once the new UI's Make integration lands.)                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                         
  - make dev — backend dev server for end-to-end verification of the registration call                                                                     
  - make lint — backend lint pass for any API/schema changes the dialog requires                                                                         
  - make pre-commit — pre-configured hooks                                                                                                                 
  - npm run dev / npm run test (new React UI) — local dev server and Vitest run     

---

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

  - Shadcn dialog (showing a curated set of commonly used MCP servers from the catalog) triggered from a text style button on the Connect MCP Server form  
  - Each quick-add option pre-fills the registration form with the catalog entry's defaults behind the scenes (command, transport, args, etc.)                               
  - Dialog includes a clearly labeled link to the full server catalog view
  - Curated list is sourced from the existing catalog data (no hardcoded duplicate of catalog entries)                                                     
  - Dialog is reachable from both onboarding and the standard "add server" path                                                                          
  - Component is fully typed (TypeScript) and strings routed through FormatJS for i18n                                                                     
  - Dark/light mode styling matches the rest of the new UI                                                                                                 
  - Keyboard navigation and focus handling (open, select, close, escape) verified                                                                          
  - Vitest + React Testing Library coverage for: dialog open/close, option selection pre-fills the form, link navigates to catalog, empty/error states                                                                                                                                                   
  - Linter and type-check pass cleanly                                                                                                                     
  - CI passes with no regressions     
  
---

### 🧩 Additional Context

  - Define what makes a server "commonly used." Can we get data on popularity/install-count? Afaik we don't have it for CF, but can we get this data from the third party sources on general popularity/install-count? @jonpspri                                                                   
  - No backend changes expected if the catalog API already exposes the needed fields, but from team discussion on May5, it sounds like we may need a new endpoint? Verify if this is accurate.

comments.author: m13v
comments.body: scenario: someone ships an MCP server for WhatsApp on macOS into a catalog like this. user clicks quick-add, dialog pre-fills command/transport/args, registration shows green. first tool call hits a TCC prompt for Accessibility, but the prompt is parented to the admin UI process so it silently denies. user thinks the server is broken; catalog thinks it's registered. the gap is the catalog's idea of 'registered' stops at config validity, not capability. one-click flows need a post-add probe that runs one real tool call against the server before declaring success, otherwise OS-deps servers ship a false-success state. catalog metadata should also flag entries with OS prereqs (accessibility, screen recording, full disk) so the dialog warns before the click rather than after.
